caption: The drawing depicts a metal object with three orthogonal views: a perspective view in the lower right, a top view in the upper center, and a side view directly below the top view. The object consists of a flat, elongated blade or spatula protruding from a rectangular or arched metal frame supported by four legs. The frame features decorative, symmetrical coil or scroll elements along its sides and intersections. In the top view, the handle appears as an elongated rectangle, colored in a light shade, while the metal frame forms an arch with a pair of symmetrical curled designs inside. The side view displays the object’s flatness and the four perpendicular legs supporting the frame. The main color of the drawing is grayscale, rendered in delicate pencil or ink on a plain, beige background, and there is a small ruler for scale under the side view as well as a handwritten signature “Lazar Rubinstein” in the lower left corner.
title: Flat Iron Holder
